name: GSC Popcorn Run 2026
short_description: The GSC x Alliance Bank Popcorn Run is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Mitsui Outlet Park KLIA in Sepang, Selangor, a movie-themed race with 21 km, 10 km and 5 km categories.
ai_summary: The GSC x Alliance Bank Popcorn Run is a cinema-themed race on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Mitsui Outlet Park KLIA in Sepang, Selangor, with the event start listed at 5:00 am. It offers a 21 km half marathon with a four-hour cut-off, a 10 km competitive race (2 hours 30 minutes) and a 5 km fun run. The event is run by RUNRIO's Malaysian team under its Unrivaled Run banner, and race packs are collected on 4 and 5 December.

core_facts.venue: Mitsui Outlet Park KLIA, Persiaran Komersial

faqs.question: When is the GSC Popcorn Run taking place?
faqs.answer: The race is on Sunday 6 December 2026, with the start listed at 5:00 am. Race-pack collection runs on Friday 4 and Saturday 5 December from 10 am to 8 pm, and the organiser says there is no pack collection on race day, so runners need to collect beforehand.

faqs.question: What race categories are offered?
faqs.answer: There are three: a 21 km half marathon with a four-hour cut-off and a minimum age of 16, a 10 km competitive race with a 2 hour 30 minute cut-off, and a 5 km fun run open to ages five and up. Every category includes a movie ticket promo code.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: Start and finish are at Mitsui Outlet Park KLIA on Persiaran Komersial in Sepang, Selangor, the outlet mall a few minutes from Kuala Lumpur International Airport. With a 5:00 am start, runners coming from the Klang Valley should plan transport the night before, as public transport will not be running yet.
